instruction: What is BorrowLoop?
output: BorrowLoop is a community-based peer-to-peer sharing marketplace where users can lend and borrow household items, tools, equipment, and outdoor gear locally.

instruction: How do I list an item for rent on BorrowLoop?
output: Log in to your account, click the 'List Item' tab, fill in the item name, category, daily rental price in RM, location, description, and click 'Publish item'.

instruction: What payment methods are supported on BorrowLoop?
output: BorrowLoop supports secure payments via major Credit/Debit Cards and Malaysian Online Banking (FPX) like Maybank2u, CIMB Clicks, Public Bank, and RHB Now.

instruction: What password rules must I follow when signing up?
output: Your password must be at least 8 characters long and contain at least one uppercase letter, one lowercase letter, and one number.

instruction: Is an email required to log in or register?
output: Yes, you must provide a valid email address format (e.g., user@domain.com) along with your password to access protected pages.

instruction: What pages require me to be logged in?
output: You need to log in to access the List Item page, My Bookings, My Profile, and to proceed with booking or item checkouts.

instruction: How is the total checkout cost calculated?
output: The total cost is calculated by multiplying the daily rate by the rental duration in days, plus a flat RM 2.50 Community Protection Fee.

instruction: What is the Community Protection Fee?
output: It is a standard RM 2.50 fee added to every rental transaction to cover platform security, SSL encryption, and community protection.

instruction: How do I contact an item owner?
output: Once you have a confirmed booking, go to 'My Bookings' and click the 'Chat owner' button to send direct messages to the lender.

instruction: Can I borrow items without creating an account?
output: You can browse items freely, but you must log in or create an account when attempting to complete a booking checkout or list an item.

instruction: What item categories are available on BorrowLoop?
output: BorrowLoop features items under three main categories: Tools, Cleaning, and Outdoor equipment.

instruction: What happens if my return date is earlier than my start date?
output: The system will block the reservation and display an error message stating that the return date must be after the start date.

instruction: How do I find items close to my current location?
output: On the Browse page, click the 'Near me' button in the search bar to filter items located around your local community or neighborhood.

instruction: How do I edit my profile name?
output: Navigate to the 'Profile' section, enter your updated full name in the Name field, and click 'Save profile'.

instruction: What information is shown in the My Profile tab?
output: Your profile displays your average user rating (e.g., 4.9 stars), total booking count, identity verification status, and registered community.

instruction: How do I set a reminder to return an item?
output: Go to the 'My Bookings' section on your dashboard and click the 'Return reminder' button on your active rental card.

instruction: How does the checkout security work?
output: BorrowLoop uses 256-bit SSL encryption to safely process credit card details and online banking transactions.

instruction: What happens if I try to publish an item without an item name or price?
output: The app will display a notification saying 'Please enter item name and price' and will not allow you to publish until filled.

instruction: How are daily rental rates billed?
output: Rental days are calculated as full 24-hour days starting from your selected Start Date to your selected Return Date.

instruction: What details do I need to provide for Credit Card payments?
output: You must provide the Cardholder Name, Card Number, Expiry Date (MM/YY), and CVV security code.

instruction: What banks are available for Online Banking (FPX)?
output: You can select Maybank2u, CIMB Clicks, Public Bank, or RHB Now at checkout.

instruction: Where do I check my past and active rentals?
output: All active, paid, and confirmed items appear on your 'My Bookings' page.

instruction: What should I do if I forget my password?
output: You can re-register or contact platform support to trigger a credential reset for your registered email.

instruction: Who sets the daily price for rented items?
output: Item owners set their own daily rental prices in RM when listing equipment on the platform.

instruction: How do I search for a specific tool like a drill or ladder?
output: Use the search bar on the home page to filter available items by typing keywords like 'Drill' or 'Ladder'.

instruction: Is there a deposit required to borrow items?
output: Payment totals include your daily rental rate and protection fee. Deposit rules vary depending on verified lender requirements.

instruction: How do I sign out of BorrowLoop?
output: Click the Logout button located at the top-right corner of the navigation bar.

instruction: What items are available in the Cleaning category?
output: Common cleaning equipment includes Carpet Cleaners, Pressure Washers, and heavy-duty vacuums.

instruction: What items are available in the Tools category?
output: Tools include equipment like Extension Ladders, Tile Cutters, Cordless Drill Sets, and general hand tools.

instruction: How does BorrowLoop promote sustainability?
output: By enabling neighbor-to-neighbor sharing, BorrowLoop reduces unnecessary consumer purchasing, landfill waste, and product consumption.

instruction: Why was my password rejected during sign up?
output: Your password was likely rejected because it lacked an uppercase letter, lowercase letter, number, or was under 8 characters long.

instruction: What happens if I try to sign up with an invalid email?
output: The form displays an error stating 'Please enter a valid email address.' and prevents account creation.

instruction: Can I reserve an item for just 1 day?
output: Yes, selecting the same start and end date counts as a 1-day rental.

instruction: Where are items stored when I publish them?
output: Listings are stored locally in the browser storage and are instantly available under the 'Available nearby' grid.

instruction: Can I cancel a booking after paying?
output: You can view active bookings under 'My Bookings' and message the owner directly to negotiate a schedule change or cancellation.

instruction: Is there a guest checkout option available?
output: No guest checkout is allowed; users are redirected to log in or register before completing payment.

instruction: How do I know if an item owner is verified?
output: Listed item cards display a 'Verified owner' badge next to the owner's profile info.

instruction: What items are under the Outdoor category?
output: The Outdoor category includes gear like camping tents, sleeping bags, and portable outdoor gear.

instruction: How do I clear category filters when browsing?
output: Click the 'All' filter button above the item grid to view all listings across all categories.

instruction: How much does a Carpet Cleaner cost per day on BorrowLoop?
output: The default Carpet Cleaner listing starts at RM 25 per day.

instruction: How much does a Cordless Drill Set cost per day?
output: The default Cordless Drill Set listing starts at RM 12 per day.

instruction: What is the fee for an Extension Ladder?
output: The default Extension Ladder rental rate is RM 15 per day.

instruction: Can I modify my listing price after publishing?
output: Currently, you can publish items with a specific price; updates can be managed through profile dashboard management.

instruction: How do I switch between Login and Signup modes?
output: Inside the authentication modal, click the 'Log In' or 'Sign Up' tab at the top of the form.

instruction: Does BorrowLoop keep my payment credentials safe?
output: Yes, payment forms use 256-bit SSL encrypted channels and do not store raw card numbers locally.

instruction: What happens if I click 'List Item' while logged out?
output: The app shows a notification saying 'Please log in to view this page' and automatically opens the login dialog.

instruction: How can I check if my payment went through?
output: A successful payment displays a confirmation toast and automatically creates an entry under 'My Bookings'.

instruction: What is the identity verification status on my profile?
output: All active registered users receive a default 'Verified' status badge on their profile dashboard.

instruction: Can I communicate with owners before booking?
output: You can click 'View' on any item card to review details and request a booking to open direct messaging.

instruction: Who can I ask if I get stuck while using BorrowLoop?
output: You can ask BorrowBot, our 24/7 AI Customer Support assistant available via the floating chat widget!
